label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (sql-injection) is alert-TP. User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly into the SQL string construction at line 22 ('UPDATE ...'). No sanitization or parameterized query usage is applied. Although execution is noted as occurring outside this method, the construction of dynamic SQL with unsanitized input represents a confirmed vulnerability pattern consistent with the sqli-00 benchmark designation.

evidence.note: User input param concatenated into SQL string q, then stored in request attribute
